SourceFiniteMax.statement: def SourceFiniteMax {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (x : E) : EReal

SourceActiveSubgradientUnion.statement: def SourceActiveSubgradientUnion {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (x : E) : Set E

active_subgradient_support_max.statement: theorem active_subgradient_support_max {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (x : E) : SourceActiveSubgradientUnion f x ⊆ SourceSubdifferential (SourceFiniteMax f) x

finiteMax_attained.statement: theorem finiteMax_attained {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (x : E) : ∃ i, SourceFiniteMax f x = f i x

finiteMax_point_finite.statement: theorem finiteMax_point_finite {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (hp : ∀ i, SourceProper (f i)) (x : E) (hx : ∀ i, x ∈ effectiveDomain (f i)) : ∃ a : ℝ, SourceFiniteMax f x = (a : EReal)

subgradient_iff_real_support.statement: theorem subgradient_iff_real_support (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ y, f y ≠ ⊥) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ effectiveDomain f) (g : E) : g ∈ SourceSubdifferential f x ↔ ∀ y, f y ≠ ⊤ → (f x).toReal + inner ℝ g (y - x) ≤ (f y).toReal

convex_sourceSubdifferential.statement: theorem convex_sourceSubdifferential (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ y, f y ≠ ⊥) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ effectiveDomain f) : Convex ℝ (SourceSubdifferential f x)

continuousAt_mem_domain_interior.statement: theorem continuousAt_mem_domain_interior (f : E → EReal) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ effectiveDomain f) (hc : ContinuousAt f x) : x ∈ interior (effectiveDomain f)

finiteMax_ne_bot.statement: theorem finiteMax_ne_bot {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (hp : ∀ i, SourceProper (f i)) (y : E) : SourceFiniteMax f y ≠ ⊥

convexHull_active_support_max.statement: theorem convexHull_active_support_max {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (hp : ∀ i, SourceProper (f i)) (x : E) (hx : ∀ i, x ∈ effectiveDomain (f i)) : convexHull ℝ (SourceActiveSubgradientUnion f x) ⊆ SourceSubdifferential (SourceFiniteMax f) x

isClosed_sourceSubdifferential.statement: theorem isClosed_sourceSubdifferential (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ y, f y ≠ ⊥) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ effectiveDomain f) : IsClosed (SourceSubdifferential f x)

isCompact_sourceSubdifferential.statement: theorem isCompact_sourceSubdifferential [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (f : E → EReal) (hp : SourceProper f) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ interior (effectiveDomain f)) : IsCompact (SourceSubdifferential f x)

isCompact_convexJoin.statement: theorem isCompact_convexJoin (s t : Set E) (hs : IsCompact s) (ht : IsCompact t) : IsCompact (convexJoin ℝ s t)

isCompact_convexHull_finite_convex_union.statement: theorem isCompact_convexHull_finite_convex_union {ι : Type*} (s : ι → Set E) (F : Finset ι) (hc : ∀ i ∈ F, Convex ℝ (s i)) (hk : ∀ i ∈ F, IsCompact (s i)) : IsCompact (convexHull ℝ (⋃ i ∈ F, s i))

isCompact_active_subgradient_hull.statement: theorem isCompact_active_subgradient_hull [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (hp : ∀ i, SourceProper (f i)) (hc : ∀ i, IsConvexExtended (f i)) (x : E) (hx : ∀ i, x ∈ effectiveDomain (f i)) (hcont : ∀ i, ContinuousAt (f i) x) : IsCompact (convexHull ℝ (SourceActiveSubgradientUnion f x))

continuousAt_finite_toReal.statement: theorem continuousAt_finite_toReal (f : E → EReal) (x : E) (ht : f x ≠ ⊤) (hb : f x ≠ ⊥) (hc : ContinuousAt f x) : ContinuousAt (fun y => (f y).toReal) x

max_support_displacement_compare.statement: theorem max_support_displacement_compare {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (hp : ∀ i, SourceProper (f i)) (x : E) (hx : ∀ i, x ∈ effectiveDomain (f i)) (y : E) (i : ι) (hy : y ∈ effectiveDomain (f i)) (hi : SourceFiniteMax f y = f i y) (g k : E) (hg : g ∈ SourceSubdifferential (SourceFiniteMax f) x) (hk : k ∈ SourceSubdifferential (f i) y) : inner ℝ g (y - x) ≤ inner ℝ k (y - x)

max_subgradient_direction_witness.statement: theorem max_subgradient_direction_witness [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (hp : ∀ i, SourceProper (f i)) (hc : ∀ i, IsConvexExtended (f i)) (x : E) (hx : ∀ i, x ∈ effectiveDomain (f i)) (hcont : ∀ i, ContinuousAt (f i) x) (g d : E) (hg : g ∈ SourceSubdifferential (SourceFiniteMax f) x) : ∃ k ∈ SourceActiveSubgradientUnion f x, inner ℝ g d ≤ inner ℝ k d

theorem_2_26.statement: theorem theorem_2_26 [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (hp : ∀ i, SourceProper (f i)) (hc : ∀ i, IsConvexExtended (f i)) (x : E) (hx : ∀ i, x ∈ effectiveDomain (f i)) (hcont : ∀ i, ContinuousAt (f i) x) : SourceSubdifferential (SourceFiniteMax f) x = convexHull ℝ (SourceActiveSubgradientUnion f x)
